q: Which countries do you help with?
a: We specialise in Europe — including the UK, Ireland, Germany, France, Italy, the Netherlands, Poland, Malta and many more. See the full list on our Countries page.

Ideally 8–12 months before your intended intake. That leaves comfortable time for shortlisting, tests, applications and the visa process. If your timeline is shorter, talk to us — we'll tell you honestly what's still possible.

q: Do I need IELTS or another English test?
a: It depends on the country, university and course. Many institutions ask for a test score, while some accept alternatives. We'll check the exact requirement for each university on your shortlist.

q: Can you guarantee admission or a visa?
a: No honest consultant can — decisions are made by universities and immigration authorities. What we do guarantee is careful guidance and a well-prepared application to give you the strongest possible chance.

q: How do I book a counselling session?
a: Fill in the form on our Contact page, call or WhatsApp us, or visit our head office in Surat.

q: I don't live in Surat. Can you still help me?
a: Yes. We accept files from students wherever they are. Get in touch by call or WhatsApp and our team will guide you on the next steps.
